payload.body:
:eye: **Cyclops Review**

Reviewed PR #6632's slice parsing and TIP-20 prewarming changes. One low-severity consistency issue was identified in the TIP-20 prewarm decoder and is commented inline.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Non-canonical TIP-20 ABI policy:** Decide whether Tempo precompiles intentionally accept non-canonical address padding; the pool prewarmer should not be the only component enforcing canonical address words.
- ⚡ **Future decoder reuse:** `decode_tip20_warmable_call` is currently performance-only. Avoid reusing it for transaction validity or payment classification unless its decoding policy is aligned with execution.
- ⚡ **DEX route helper invariant:** `validate_and_build_route` is private and current callers build at least two-token routes, but `array_windows::<2>()` silently yields no hops for shorter slices. Add an explicit length guard if this helper is reused from a less-constrained path.
</details>

payload.body:
## `cargo asm` before/after

Tempo-only rows for the changes currently included in this PR.

Command shape:
```sh
cargo asm -p <crate> --lib --json | rg '<symbol>'
```

The `size` field is the emitted release symbol size reported by `cargo asm --json` on local `aarch64-apple-darwin`. This is local codegen evidence, not an end-to-end benchmark claim.

| Included change | Symbol / evidence | Before | After | Delta |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `perf(primitives): chunk transaction signature parsing` | `tempo_primitives::transaction::tt_signature::PrimitiveSignature::from_bytes` | 406 | 374 | -32 (-7.9%) |
| `perf(precompiles): chunk bytes-like storage writes` | both `store_bytes_like` monomorphs | 665 | 611 | -54 (-8.1%) |
| `perf(primitives): avoid P256 address derivation allocation` | `derive_p256_address` | 104 | 55 | -49 (-47.1%) |
| `perf(primitives): avoid P256 address derivation allocation` | `PrimitiveSignature::recover_signer` | 2783 | 2730 | -53 (-1.9%) |
| `perf(precompiles): iterate DEX route windows` | `StablecoinDEX::validate_and_build_route` | 890 | 849 | -41 (-4.6%) |
| `perf(precompiles): simplify selector extraction` | `selector_from_calldata` | n/a | n/a | helper inlined; no standalone release symbol |
| `perf(evm): split system tx metadata suffix` | `validate_system_tx` | n/a | n/a | no clean standalone release symbol; covered by `tempo-evm` check |

## Included Tempo changes

| Package | Included change | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tempo-precompiles` | Read calldata selectors with `first_chunk::<4>()` | committed; helper is inlined in release builds |
| `tempo-precompiles` | Use `array_windows::<2>()` for adjacent DEX route hops | `validate_and_build_route` shrank 890 -> 849 bytes |
| `tempo-primitives` | Parse fixed P256/WebAuthn signature fields with chunk splitting | `PrimitiveSignature::from_bytes` shrank 406 -> 374 bytes |
| `tempo-evm` | Split fixed system tx metadata suffix without manual tail slicing | committed; covered by `tempo-evm` check |
| `tempo-precompiles` | Iterate long bytes/string storage writes with `bytes.chunks(32).enumerate()` | `store_bytes_like` monomorphs shrank 665 -> 611 bytes |
| `tempo-primitives` | Build the P256 public-key hash preimage on the stack instead of `Vec::concat()` | `derive_p256_address` shrank 104 -> 55 bytes; caller shrank 2783 -> 2730 bytes |

## Validation

Post-rewrite checks run locally:
- `cargo +nightly fmt --all --check`
- `cargo test -p tempo-primitives p256`
- `cargo test -p tempo-precompiles bytes_like`
- `cargo check -p tempo-precompiles`
- `cargo check -p tempo-evm`
- `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD`

payload.author: tempoxyz-bot
payload.body:
:eye: **Cyclops Review** — No actionable findings on current head.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Future sidecar write counting**: When TIP-1085 is implemented, ensure the handler’s counted key-authorization rows upper-bound every actual eligible zero-to-nonzero AccountKeychain slot the sidecar mutator can persist (`tips/tip-1085.md:121-134`). If an implementation could persist eligible creations that were not included in worst-case intrinsic gas, those writes could become free and refundable.
- ⚡ **Credit backing and bookkeeping atomicity**: Implement the access-key credit debit, TIP-1060 token consumption, Direct/Preserve mode choice, and bookkeeping-slot clear-on-zero as one atomic unit (`tips/tip-1085.md:64-66`, `tips/tip-1085.md:105-115`). This should be covered by property tests to avoid double-consuming backing tokens or leaving unbacked credits.
- ⚡ **Sidecar revert boundary**: The spec requires sidecar storage, credit debit, and refund settlement to persist together even if later user EVM execution reverts (`tips/tip-1085.md:136-140`). A future implementation should place the refund/credit update at the same checkpoint boundary as the sidecar storage commit.
- ⚡ **Saturation/orphan backing tokens**: At `uint64::MAX`, additional deletions saturate the per-account credit counter while still producing AccountKeychain TIP-1060 backing (`tips/tip-1085.md:66`, `tips/tip-1085.md:89-95`). Implementers should ensure any surplus backing cannot later be spent by a different account.
- ⚡ **Canonical storage layout before finalization**: The draft permits any internal layout for `access_key_storage_credits` (`tips/tip-1085.md:62`). If independent clients must derive an identical state root from the TIP, the final spec should make the physical storage/state-root treatment unambiguous.
</details>

payload.title: feat(nonce): implement TIP-1077 time wheel

payload.author: tempoxyz-bot
payload.body:
:eye: **Cyclops Review**

PR #6619 implements TIP-1077's T8 expiring-nonce time-wheel replay table and updates pool, gas, and prewarming code to use it. I found 2 actionable issues: a missing migration replay check in execution, and incomplete pool state-update handling for shared replay cells.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Hardfork-bound pool indexing:** Expiring-nonce transactions admitted before T8 are registered under the legacy `expiring_nonce_seen` slot, while post-activation execution writes time-wheel cells. On the T8 transition, reindex, flush, or revalidate existing expiring-nonce pool entries so mined transactions do not linger under the wrong slot model.
- ⚡ **Prewarming thread-local lifecycle:** `BestTransactionsPrewarming` now stores EVM state in a custom `thread_local!` and clears Rayon workers via broadcast. Review whether `WorkerPool::in_place_scope`'s calling thread can retain a stale prewarm EVM/provider/cache between payloads; reports found this likely perf-only, but it deserves a human check.
</details>

:eye: **Cyclops Review** — No actionable findings.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Ungated swap refactor:** `crates/precompiles/src/stablecoin_dex/mod.rs:1181` and `crates/precompiles/src/stablecoin_dex/mod.rs:1199` affect active T4 swap execution and historical re-execution. Workers found the extracted traversal faithful, but this remains the highest-value area for a maintainer to confirm with the DEX differential/parity test suite.
- ⚡ **T8 quote gas profile:** `crates/precompiles/src/stablecoin_dex/mod.rs:1484` and `crates/precompiles/src/stablecoin_dex/mod.rs:1748` make future T8 quotes traverse individual orders instead of tick aggregates. Reads are gas-metered, but routers using on-chain quotes should account for higher gas on fragmented books before T8 activation.
- ⚡ **Traversal assumption:** `crates/precompiles/src/stablecoin_dex/mod.rs:1275` relies on `next_initialized_tick` remaining exclusive of the current tick. A future change making that helper inclusive would break read-only quote cursor parity with mutating fills, so a guard comment or regression test would be useful.
- ⚡ **Invariant test setup:** `tips/verify/test/invariants/StablecoinDEX.t.sol:930` and `tips/verify/test/invariants/StablecoinDEX.t.sol:1004` assert that a successful quote implies the swap should not revert. This is appropriate only while fuzz actors remain funded/approved and not policy- or pause-blocked, since production swaps perform balance/policy/final-transfer checks that quotes do not.
</details>

payload.author: tempoxyz-bot
payload.body:
:eye: **Cyclops Review**

PR #6613 mostly updates Reth dependencies, but one verified integration issue remains: locally built payloads drop sparse-trie changed paths, which can disable Reth's in-memory sparse-trie pruning and create a validator resource/liveness risk.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Tempo payload ID override vs upstream Amsterdam fields**: Tempo overrides upstream Reth payload ID hashing and currently sets `slot_number`/`target_gas_limit` to `None` in the T4 consensus path. Revisit this before enabling non-`None` values on Engine API payload builds.
- ⚡ **State-root task parallelism/configuration**: The Reth bump changes state-root task parallelism gating. Both sparse-task and synchronous fallback paths compute the same root, but production configs should still be checked for expected `trie_handle` availability.
</details>

:eye: **Cyclops Review** — No actionable findings.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **AMM reserve-accounting rollback assumptions**: AMM paths such as `rebalance_swap` and `burn` write pool reserves before subsequent TIP-20 transfers. This is safe when called inside an EVM-journaled frame that reverts on precompile errors; reviewers should confirm no current or future non-journaled storage-action path calls these functions.
- ⚡ **TIP-1042 stranded-fee/asymmetry behavior**: At T8, fee collection can accept same-token fees even if the FeeManager is not recipient-authorized, while `distribute_fees`, `mint`, `burn`, and `rebalance_swap` still use normal TIP-20 policy enforcement. This matches the spec but can strand balances/liquidity; operators should understand the activation and policy implications.
- ⚡ **Pre-existing receive-policy/reserve accounting edge**: One worker flagged an exotic configuration where `system_transfer_from` plus a TIP-1028 receive-policy diversion could cause `mint` reserve accounting to assume a validator-token deposit reached the FeeManager even if inbound handling diverts funds. Not introduced by this PR, but worth a targeted human check if FeeManager receive policies can be enabled.
- ⚡ **LP recipient footgun**: `mint` rejects zero/TIP-20/virtual LP recipients at T8 but does not reject `to == TIP_FEE_MANAGER_ADDRESS`; LP shares sent to the precompile address would likely be unburnable. Consider explicitly rejecting the FeeManager address if this is not intended.

</details>

PR #6604 adds draft TIP-1042 for FeeAMM/TIP-403 policy exemptions. The change is documentation-only, but two actionable spec/implementation issues remain; inline comments are attached.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Role-specific TIP-1015 checks**: Future implementation should use the existing role-aware authorization helpers (`AuthRole::Sender` / `AuthRole::Recipient`) rather than raw policy reads, so compound sender/recipient sub-policies match TIP-20 behavior.
- ⚡ **Virtual-address semantics for `mint(to)`**: TIP-20 resolves virtual recipients before authorization, while FeeAMM LP balances are currently keyed by the raw `to` address. Decide whether new LP-recipient gates should resolve, reject, or document virtual LP recipients before implementation.
- ⚡ **Draft-only invariants**: The current Rust code does not yet include the proposed `mint`/`burn` gates or the fee-collection exemption. Re-audit the implementation PR for exact gate ordering, reserve mutation ordering, and tests covering both `rebalanceSwap` directions.
</details>

payload.author: decofe
payload.title: Add T9 hardfork plumbing

payload.author: mattsse
payload.body:
The T9 Rust/chainspec plumbing looks good and the focused tests pass locally, but the manual bench comment parser still needs the new hardfork in its allowlist. Right now `@decofe bench ... baseline-hardfork=T9 feature-hardfork=T9` would be rejected before it reaches the updated `tempo.nu` path, even though `tempo-hardforks` now returns `T9`.

Suggested follow-up:

```diff
diff --git a/.github/workflows/bench.yml b/.github/workflows/bench.yml
@@
-            const hardforkValues = new Set(['T0', 'T1', 'T1A', 'T1B', 'T1C', 'T2', 'T3', 'T4', 'T5', 'T6', 'T7', 'T8']);
+            const hardforkValues = new Set(['T0', 'T1', 'T1A', 'T1B', 'T1C', 'T2', 'T3', 'T4', 'T5', 'T6', 'T7', 'T8', 'T9']);
```

The two usage strings below that line should also include `T9`, so the error/help text matches the validator.

Validated at `db160817f`:
- `cargo test -p tempo-hardfork --lib`
- `cargo test -p tempo-chainspec --features cli`
- `nu -c 'source tempo.nu; tempo-hardforks'` includes `T9`.

:eye: **Cyclops Review** — No actionable findings.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Non-production raw-slot assumptions:** Foundry verification helpers/docs still describe old transient-tail FeeAMM slot numbers (`tips/verify/test/helpers/InvariantBase.sol:165`, `tips/verify/test/invariants/FeeAMM.t.sol:119`, `tips/verify/test/invariants/README.md:160`). These are not production paths, but should be updated so future invariant tests do not encode obsolete transient slot numbers.
- ⚡ **`StorageCredits` raw-revm coupling:** The precompile and opcode-level accounting both rely on `STORAGE_CREDITS_ADDRESS` plus `StorageCredits::slot(account)` (`crates/precompiles/src/storage_credits/mod.rs:198`, `crates/precompiles/src/storage_credits/accounting.rs:129`, `crates/revm/src/gas_credits.rs:43`). Future changes to either derivation must be mirrored across both paths.
- ⚡ **Explicit transient mapping mode in macro inputs:** Current contracts select transient mapping storage with `#[transient]`; no production field declares `Mapping<_, _, Transient>` directly. If future code does, re-check macro parsing around `extract_mapping_types` (`crates/precompiles-macros/src/utils.rs:236`) or reject explicit third generic parameters to avoid confusing layout generation.
- ⚡ **Debug-only collision checks for manual slots:** Persistent and transient collision checks remain debug-assertion-only (`crates/precompiles-macros/src/layout.rs:203`). This is pre-existing behavior, but manual `#[slot(N)]` assignments in either storage space should be reviewed carefully in release builds.
- ⚡ **Off-chain transient-slot tooling:** Transient slot numbers for migrated fields now start from zero in `transient_slots::*`. Any off-chain tracer/indexer decoding debug traces using the old combined-layout slot numbers should be updated.
</details>

PR #6546's T8-gated versioned Stablecoin DEX order storage does not show a currently exploitable security issue. The remaining actionable items are low-severity hardening/documentation/test gaps around the new legacy/V1 storage boundary.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Head drift checked:** Reports were produced against `bddba668a8c5`; current head is `b7b82478d1cf5b5d6f361d5ab275f4f9d7cf2ed3`. All retained findings still apply to the current diff.
- ⚡ **Cache rollback exploitability:** The non-transactional cache is not currently reachable as a committed corruption path because post-rewrite failures propagate as system errors. Re-review if future business logic is added after the T8 flip rewrite and before checkpoint commit.
- ⚡ **Credit parity is physical, not logical:** V1 may free packed pointer slots at different times than legacy. This appears TIP-1064-consistent; test conservation, not exact timing parity.
</details>

PR #6505 replaces the hand-written precompile selector scheduling/dispatch plumbing with a shared `dispatch!` macro and local `#[schedule(...)]` annotations. The reports found no exploitable security issue in the current ABIs; one low-severity defense-in-depth item remains around multi-interface selector collisions and dispatch priority.

**Findings:**
- 🛡️ **[DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH]** Assert disjoint selectors for multi-interface dispatch (`crates/precompiles/src/dispatch.rs:192`)

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **Hardfork schedule annotations:** Since the centralized `SelectorSchedule` arrays were removed, future fork-gated precompile selectors now depend on the correct local `#[schedule(...)]` attribute being present beside each dispatch arm.
- ⚡ **Macro dispatch semantics:** The macro pre-gates selectors before decoding and recursively picks the first interface with a matching selector. Review future multi-interface uses carefully, especially if new ABI methods are added to existing grouped interfaces.
</details>

PR #6502 refactors FeeAMM fee-swap settlement into a domain-specific `fee_amm_swap`/`StorageAction::FeeAmmSwap` path and introduces the `StorageOps::zero_init_packed_store()` hook. The worker reports and verifier agreed the change is state-, gas-, and reconstruction-equivalent for current in-repo execution paths.

<details>
<summary>Reviewer Callouts</summary>

- ⚡ **External storage-action trace consumers:** Out-of-repo builders, validators, replay tools, or future BlockSTM integrations that consume `StorageAction` traces must add support for `StorageAction::FeeAmmSwap` (`crates/precompiles/src/storage/actions.rs:37`) and source the pool slot pre-state because the EVM implementation records a semantic action rather than the previous explicit pool `Sload`/`Sstore` pair (`crates/precompiles/src/storage/evm.rs:471`, `crates/evm/src/evm.rs:598`).
- ⚡ **Future `zero_init_packed_store()` overrides:** The packed-store refactor is currently safe because live storage uses the default hardfork-gated hook (`crates/precompiles/src/storage/mod.rs:228`, `crates/precompiles/src/storage/thread_local.rs:235`) and only in-memory `PackedSlot` overrides it (`crates/precompiles/src/storage/packing.rs:31`). Future live non-zero packed-store backends should not override this hook without preserving hardfork semantics.
- ⚡ **Future semantic batching / parallel execution:** `FeeAmmSwap` is a semantic delta over a packed AMM pool slot. Any future executor that aggregates same-pool swaps should re-run aggregate liquidity and `u128` overflow validation with the same helper used by execution (`crates/precompiles/src/tip_fee_manager/amm.rs:86`).
</details>
